title: 第三章 双生武魂(三)
content_zh:
唐三从未见过父亲的脸色如此精彩过，各种复杂的情绪不断出现在唐昊脸上，良久，他才徐徐说出一句话，“
唐三不明所以的点了点头。唐昊站起身，头也不回的回里间去了。
一边弄着午饭，唐三一边思考着今天接触的武魂世界，双生武魂，似乎在这个世界中应该很少存在，否则，父亲也不会那么吃惊了。看样子，自己那个锤子武魂好像令他触动很大。
对于他来说，更重要的却是武魂与玄天功之间的关系，如果那个魂环就是自己玄天功无法突破的关键，那么，不论怎样，都要想办法来得到一个魂环试验一下。
午饭时，唐昊显得很沉默，就连饭量也似乎比往日少了许多，目光不时落在唐三身上，仿佛在犹豫着什么。
吃完午饭，唐三习惯性的准备收拾碗筷，却被唐昊叫住了。
“等会儿再收拾吧。小三，我问你，你想不想成为一名魂师？”
唐三愣了一下，看向唐昊，他不愿意欺骗父亲，犹豫片刻后，还是点了点头。
唐昊叹息一声，面庞看上去更加苍老了几分，“你终究还是要选择走向这条道路。”他只是再说了这一句话，就又回自己的房间去了。
唐三发现，唐昊在感叹的时候，情绪中有失望但更多的却是一种欣慰的表情。他明白，在自己这位父亲心中，似乎隐藏着很多事。
收拾完碗筷，唐三回到自己的房间继续他的工作，铸造锤与铁块碰撞的叮当声有节奏的响起。虽然不知道什么时候能够将这块生铁打造到唐昊要求的拳头大小，但这种铸造的方式对于提升他对玄天功的使用却有着不小的好处，对身体锻炼的效果也不错。唐三已经开始尝试着用尽可能少的玄天功内力来挥动铁锤，这样，他在每一次连续挥击的时候就能维持更长的时间。
当下午的敲打进行到三百多下，感觉上又令那块生铁祛除了一些杂质时，门帘掀起，唐昊走了进来。他今天下午似乎并没有打造农具，至少唐三没有听到熟悉的敲打声。
“爸爸。”唐三看向父亲，手中的铁锤不自觉的停了下来。
唐昊做了一个让他继续的手势，就走到一旁站定，也不开口，只是看着他。
唐三这才继续挥锤，此时，他身上的衣服已经被汗水浸透了。以他现在的内力，还不足以达到去适应温度的程度，更何况，这绝对是一项重体力劳动。
当，当，当，当，当……，敲击声不断响起，唐三幼小的身体和手中的铁锤并不成比例，但铁锤每一次抡起却是虎虎生风。
唐昊心中暗道，天生神力加上先天满魂力，难怪他这么小就能挥动铁锤。老杰克的话或许是对的，不应该因为自己的颓废而影响到这个孩子的发展，今后的路，就让他自己去走吧。
看着挥汗如雨的唐三，唐昊终于下定了决心。
“停一下。”唐昊开口道。
唐三放下手中的铁锤，微微有些喘息，悄然催动体内的玄天功调息，以恢复自己的体力。

唐昊走到唐三面前，拿过他手中的铁锤，再看看火炉上烧的通红的铁块，“像你这样敲打，就算是一年也无法让它变成拳头大小。”
唐三仰起头看着高大的父亲，“那我该怎么做？”
唐昊冷淡的道：“告诉我，当你挥动铸造锤敲击它的时候，身体什么地方最先发力？”
唐三想了想，道：“应该是腰吧。从腰部带动背部，然后再带动手臂抡起铸造锤？”
唐昊并没有肯定或者否认唐三的说法，继续问道，“人身体除了大脑以外，最重要的是什么地方？”
“是心脏。”唐三毫不犹豫的回答。心脏和大脑同样是瞬间致命的地方，而大脑还有头骨保护，心脏却只有皮肤与肌肉而已。作为唐门弟子，对于人体结构他清楚的很，用暗器刺穿敌人心脏，是最有效也是最简洁的致命方法。
唐昊停顿了一下，才道：“那你再告诉我，一个人有几颗心脏。”
“啊？”唐三吃惊的看着他，有些摸不着头脑。人有几颗心脏还用说么？
“回答我。”唐昊冷冷的看着他，身材与气息上的压迫力令唐三有些喘不过气来。
“一颗。”
唐昊摇了摇头，道：“不，你错了。
“三颗？”唐三目瞪口呆的看着唐昊，不明白他是什么意思。
唐昊倒转手中的铸造锤，用锤柄碰了碰唐三的两条小腿，“在这里。人的两条小腿上的肌肉，就是第二和第三颗心脏。一个人，如果想要将自己的全部力量发挥出来，那么，必定是三颗心脏同时运转的结果。所以，发力时，并不是以腰为起始。三颗心脏才是起点。”
“当你胸口内的心脏急速跳动之时，从两条小腿开始法力，力量上传，到大腿，经过腰、背、手臂，最后释放出去。这才是全力一击。心脏发力，腰为轴。看着。”
content_en:
Tang San had never seen his father's expression so wonderful before. Various complex emotions continued to appear on Tang Hao's face. After a long time, he slowly said one sentence, "
Tang San nodded without knowing why. Tang Hao stood up and went back to the inner room without looking back.
While making lunch, Tang San thought about the world of martial arts he came into contact with today. Twin martial spirits seemed to rarely exist in this world, otherwise, his father wouldn't be so surprised. It seemed that his hammer martial spirit had greatly touched him.
For him, what is more important is the relationship between Wuhun and Xuantian Kung. If that soul ring is the key to his Xuantian Kung being unable to break through, then no matter what, he must find a way to get a soul ring to test it.
During lunch, Tang Hao seemed very silent, and even his appetite seemed to be much less than before. His eyes fell on Tang San from time to time, as if he was hesitating about something.
After lunch, Tang San prepared to clear away the dishes as usual, but was stopped by Tang Hao.
“We’ll clean it up later. Xiaosan, let me ask you, do you want to become a soul master? "
Tang San was stunned for a moment and looked at Tang Hao. He was unwilling to deceive his father. After hesitating for a moment, he nodded.
Tang Hao sighed, his face looking a little older, "You still have to choose this path after all. "He just said this again and went back to his room.
Tang San found that when Tang Hao sighed, there was disappointment in his mood, but more of an expression of relief. He understood that there seemed to be many things hidden in his father's heart.
After clearing away the dishes, Tang San returned to his room to continue his work. The clanking sound of the casting hammer colliding with the iron block sounded rhythmically. Although I don't know when this piece of pig iron can be made to the fist size required by Tang Hao, this casting method has great benefits in improving his use of Xuantian Technique, and it is also good for physical exercise. Tang San had begun to try to use as little internal force of Xuantian Gong as possible to swing the hammer, so that he could maintain it for a longer time with each continuous swing.
When the beating in the afternoon reached more than 300 times, and it felt like some impurities had been removed from the piece of pig iron, the door curtain was lifted and Tang Hao walked in. He didn't seem to be making farm tools this afternoon, at least Tang San didn't hear the familiar banging sound.
"Dad. "Tang San looked at his father, and the hammer in his hand stopped unconsciously.
Tang Hao made a gesture to let him continue, then walked to the side and stood still, without speaking, just looking at him.
Tang San continued to swing the hammer. At this time, his clothes were soaked with sweat. His current internal strength is not enough to adapt to the temperature, not to mention that this is definitely a heavy physical labor.
Dang, Dang, Dang, Dang, Dang..., the sound of knocking continued. Tang San's young body was not proportional to the hammer in his hand, but every time he swung the hammer, it was like a tiger's wind.
Tang Hao thought to himself, with his natural divine power and innate full soul power, no wonder he could swing a hammer at such a young age. Old Jack's words may be right. His decadence should not affect the development of this child. Let him go on his own in the future.
Looking at Tang San who was sweating profusely, Tang Hao finally made up his mind.
"Stop. "Tang Hao said.
Tang San put down the hammer in his hand, panted slightly, and quietly activated the Xuantian Technique in his body to adjust his breath to restore his physical strength.
Tang Hao walked up to Tang San, took the hammer in his hand, and looked at the red iron on the stove, "If you beat it like this, even if it takes a year, you won't be able to make it the size of a fist. "
Tang San raised his head and looked at his tall father, "Then what should I do? "
Tang Hao said coldly: "Tell me, when you swing the casting hammer to hit it, which part of the body exerts the force first? "
Tang San thought for a while and said: "It should be the waist. from the waistThe head drives the back, and then the arm drives the casting hammer? "
Tang Hao did not confirm or deny Tang San's statement, but continued to ask, "Besides the brain, what is the most important part of the human body? "
"It's the heart. "Tang San answered without hesitation. The heart and brain are both instantly fatal places, and the brain is protected by the skull, but the heart only has skin and muscles. As a disciple of the Tang Sect, he knows the structure of the human body very well. Using a hidden weapon to pierce the enemy's heart is the most effective and simplest fatal method.
Tang Hao paused for a moment and then said: "Then tell me how many hearts a person has. "
"ah? "Tang San looked at him in surprise, somewhat confused. How many hearts does a person have?
"Answer me. "Tang Hao looked at him coldly, the pressure from his body and breath made Tang San somewhat breathless.
"One. "
Tang Hao shook his head and said: "No, you are wrong.
"Three?" Tang San looked at Tang Hao dumbfounded, not understanding what he meant.
Tang Hao turned the casting hammer in his hand upside down and touched Tang San's two calves with the hammer handle, "Here. The muscles on the two calves of a person are the second and third hearts. If a person wants to exert all his strength, it must be the result of three hearts running at the same time. Therefore, when exerting force, it does not start from the waist. The three hearts are the starting point."
"When the heart in your chest is beating rapidly, the mana starts from the two calves, the power is uploaded to the thighs, through the waist, back, arms, and finally released. This is a full blow. The heart exerts force, and the waist is the axis. Watch."
